name: cookie-banner
title: Cookie Banner
description: Cookie Banner is a free React cookie consent banner for Next.js and Tailwind CSS, shown as a corner card or a bottom bar, with Accept all and Reject all side by side, an options panel with a switch per category, a choice saved to localStorage with a version and an expiry, a useCookieConsent hook for holding scripts until the visitor agrees, and a cookie icon that loses a bite as they accept. It works as a cookie popup in a corner or a full width notice, and installs with the shadcn CLI.
author: Wensity <hey@wensity.com>
